description: This source file implements encoding and decoding functions for different data types (string, uint16, uint32) used in message encoding, including handling network byte order conversions.

methods.name: rtError rtEncoder_EncodeString(uint8_t ** itr,char const * s,uint32_t * n)
methods.description: Encodes a string into a buffer, prepending its length as a uint32, and advances the buffer pointer.

methods.name: rtError rtEncoder_DecodeStr(uint8_t const ** itr,char * s,uint32_t len)
methods.description: Decodes a string of specified length from the buffer into a destination string.

methods.name: rtError rtEncoder_DecodeString(uint8_t const ** itr,char * s,uint32_t * n)
methods.description: Decodes a string from the buffer, reading its length first, and updates the pointer and length accordingly.

methods.name: rtError rtEncoder_EncodeUInt16(uint8_t ** itr,uint16_t n)
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit unsigned integer into the buffer in network byte order.

methods.name: rtError rtEncoder_DecodeUInt16(uint8_t const ** itr,uint16_t * n)
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit unsigned integer from the buffer, converting from network to host byte order.

methods.name: rtError rtEncoder_EncodeUInt32(uint8_t ** itr,uint32_t n)
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit unsigned integer into the buffer in network byte order.

methods.name: rtError rtEncoder_DecodeUInt32(uint8_t const ** itr,uint32_t * n)
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit unsigned integer from the buffer, converting from network to host byte order.

ctags.name: rtEncoder_DecodeStr
ctags.pattern: /^rtEncoder_DecodeStr(uint8_t const** itr, char* s, uint32_t len)$/

ctags.pattern: /^rtEncoder_DecodeString(uint8_t const** itr, char* s, uint32_t* n)$/

ctags.name: rtEncoder_EncodeString
ctags.pattern: /^rtEncoder_EncodeString(uint8_t** itr, char const* s, uint32_t* n)$/
